sources_considered.why: Representative business survey measuring AI use in producing goods or services.
Confirms the March 28 release of the supplement and associated research.
Dated primary disclosure of a deployed generative-AI customer-service application.

evidence_items.locator: Section 3.a, AI Use Rates in the BTOS
evidence_items.explanation: The nationally weighted survey supports limited business penetration: a small minority reported AI use in production. It measures broader AI, however, and does not establish that evidence of adoption was scarce.

evidence_items.locator: First results bullet following the opening paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: Klarna reported substantial production use during its assistant's first month. This is material evidence of actual adoption, but one self-reported deployment cannot establish economy-wide prevalence or contradict a claim that adoption remained limited.

unresolved_gaps: No threshold distinguishes little evidence from sufficient evidence.
The representative survey covers broader AI, while the concrete deployment concerns generative AI.
The records do not provide a common measure of sustained integration across businesses.
